letter.company_line: Structability prepares insurance reports and scopes of work for property damage and provides structural, civil and stormwater design for residential, commercial and industrial developments.
letter.subject: Civil/Structural Engineer, Rockdale (SEEK 95876045)
paragraphs: Please accept my application for the Civil/Structural Engineer role. Splitting the week between site inspections of damaged buildings and office work on causation reports, scopes of work and design is the kind of hands on engineering I want to build my career in, and your mentoring and seminar program would help me grow quickly.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019), where I studied structural principles, construction methods and hydraulics, and in February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in Australia. That course covered AS/NZS 1170 and AS 4100, hand calculations, stormwater drainage design and technical reporting, with drawings prepared in AutoCAD, Civil 3D and Revit.

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a project-in-charge and field engineer on a community hall renovation and residential subdivision finishing works. I carried out site inspections and quality checks, reviewed structural and architectural drawings, wrote site and progress reports, and worked with clients, subcontractors and suppliers to sort out site issues.

I have not yet prepared insurance damage reports or designed timber, steel and concrete members in practice, and I would learn your methods from the team. I hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence, have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa, and am open to discussing relocation to Sydney.
My resume is attached, and I would welcome the chance to talk about the role.
